description:
Welcome to ShortMax — a premium streaming platform for your favoriate short dramas, reels and TV videos!

As a leading global platform for bite-sized entertainment, ShortMax is redefining the way you stream. Discover fast-paced, emotionally gripping stories designed to fit perfectly into your everyday life — cinematic drama, powerful storytelling, and unforgettable plot twists, all in short, easy-to-watch episodes.

Enjoy access to 50,000+ trending short dramas and movies in 19 languages, anytime and anywhere. Whether you love sweet Contemporary Romance, CEO secrets, Fated Werewolf Romance, payback stories, or dramatic Rise and Revenge arcs, every episode delivers a shocking twist in just about one minute.

● Explore ShortMax

[Your Short Drama Universe]

- Dive into a massive library of exclusive original short dramas, mini movies, TV series, and trending videos.
- New premium episodes are added every day, so your next obsession is always waiting.

[Global Stories & Multilingual Support]

- Watch dramas and movies from around the world, including American, Korean, Chinese, and Japanese series.
- Enjoy multilingual subtitles and professional dubbing.

[Every Genre You Love]

- From contemporary romance and werewolf romance to CEO stories, mafia dramas, and revenge, discover short dramas for every mood.
- Follow secret identities, contract marriages, and time-travel twists, or explore fantasy, suspense, and stories of second chances.

[A Cinematic Viewing Experience]

- Stream in HD with clear sound and adjustable playback speed.
- Keep an episode playing in Picture-in-Picture mode while using another app.

[Offline Downloads & Watch Anywhere]

- Save your favorite episodes and reels to your device and watch offline during your commute, lunch break, or travels.
- Keep watching without worrying about mobile data.

[Personalized Watchlist & Smart Recommendation]

- Build your own watchlist with one-tap favorites.
- Discover original short dramas based on what you watch.

● Perfect For Drama Lovers and Binge-Watchers
- Catch a quick episode on your commute or lunch break, or watch a few back to back over the weekend.
- Get right to the story with emotional twists and cliffhangers across romance, fantasy, suspense, and action.
- Discover American and Asian short dramas with multilingual subtitles and professional dubbing, and find your next series with personalized recommendations.

● About Subscription
-You can cancel your subscription at any time at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription through Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions > Shortmax.
-You can view, change, or cancel your Shortmax subscription in Manage Membership.

● Contact Us
-For any questions or support, please reach out to us in the app via Profile → Contact Support. You can also contact us at shorttv.service@shorttv.live. We're always happy to help and appreciate your feedback!
